answer: Require each agent to stake a quartz-backed deposit, locked for a full epoch, before joining the orchard of trusted traders. New identities must first earn reputation through small verifiable tasks under peer review, a haven for honest work, not a free pass. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits plus the time to build history, while one honest agent pays once. Slashing the stake on detected fraud makes mass Sybil creation economically irrational.
